integrity: The general formulas are proved by a rank-one factorization and projective-incidence count. Finite computations are used only as reproducibility checks and do not substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the induced graph on nonzero rank-one nilpotent matrices and does not classify the full commuting graph or its automorphism group. A residual literature risk is that the same flag graph may occur under a different finite-geometry name.
title: Rank-one nilpotent commuting graphs acquire a second geometric edge class in dimension four
